veranderings.blok: Waarom 'n ketel meer vra as 'n radio
veranderings.rede: As a multiplier the plural 'kere' is the standard form, and 'baie keer' also reads as 'often', which blurs the comparison.

veranderings.voor: niks daarmee te doen gehad het nie
veranderings.na: niks daarmee te doen het nie
veranderings.rede: The rest of the sentence is in the present tense, so the past perfect is out of step; the present tense keeps the meaning (a child who is not involved) and reads more naturally.
